title: Chargers still deciding whether to exercise Quentin Johnston's fifth-year option

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chargers still deciding whether to exercise Quentin Johnston's fifth-year option
sources.description: The Chargers haven't made a call on what to do about their option on wide receiver Quentin Johnston's contract for 2027, but it doesn't look like they'll be trading him before the deadline to make that decision.
